updates.headline: Release rule: every capability must work by point-and-click, on a phone, via API and via MCP
updates.note: Owner direction: a training guide that can't be walked by point-and-click and on a phone fails. The release process (v3) now requires every capability to work on the website — point-and-click on desktop and as a full 390px phone walkthrough, with no typed URLs, API calls or scripts standing in for a step — through the API, and through an MCP tool calling the same server function with the same permissions. Test agents walk every journey on both surfaces and check the MCP tool; gaps fail as UI_GAP, MOBILE_GAP or MCP_GAP. A new feature, platform-mcp, is building the MCP server (user-created, revocable tokens; same permission checks as the API), the tool registry and a capability parity map with a check. Runs already in progress keep their current rules until their next relaunch.
